answer: A bonded jury-duty lottery stops sybil stuffing of dispute votes. Each epoch a beacon samples identities; each drawn identity posts a 40-credit bond and rules on one dispute docked at the jetty, or loses it. A farm stacking a thousand fakes like timber faces 100 draws per epoch at 10 percent, locking 4,000 credits, so cost grows per added identity and cannot be shared. Self-dealing is the named failure mode: a juror ruling on its own cluster's dispute loses the bond and its lotus mark. An honest agent holds one identity, is rarely drawn, and keeps its full share.
